question: Who won the Purple Cap for taking the most wickets in the IPL 2026 season?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kagiso Rabada.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Kagiso Rabada claimed the Purple Cap in IPL 2026 for finishing as the top wicket-taker.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kagiso Rabada won the Purple Cap award while representing the runners-up squad, Gujarat Titans.**
 
• He ended the 2026 season with a brilliant tally of 29 wickets to top the bowling charts.
 
• His stellar bowling form was vital in driving Gujarat Titans to the grand final.
 
• Kagiso Rabada__
 __
 
• Franchise - Gujarat Titans (GT)
 
• Wickets Taken - 29 wickets
 
• Accolade - Purple Cap Winner
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Purple Cap__

 __

• Rule - The bowler holding the cap changes dynamically on the field during the season based on real-time stats
